name: Messages Improved
summary: Group MMS fixes, a faster inbox and iMessage
description: Improves the stock Messages app and its providers. Group MMS goes to the right thread, and conversations open faster. Optional iMessage through your own imsg-server: pair with a code under Settings > Advanced settings and the phone registers its number, with SMS fallback.
author: thooton

changes.text: Share immutable ForegroundColorSpan and drop Log.v in MessageListItem.<init>, cache default send button drawables in onResume, guard inbox date setText.
Reuse LetterTileDrawable in-place for named contacts, guard QuickContactBadge setImageDrawable/setVisibility, cache inbox row height dimensions.
Tighten URL Linkify pre-scan for normal punctuation/times, same-String RowTextView fast-return, lazy collectPduWarmups, zero-copy rawBody and fast notice/placeholder checks.
Unpack LetterTileDrawable colors once to int[], reuse LetterTileDrawable in-place via WaveInboxUi.applyLetterAvatar, cache default contact color.
Cache Me sender label across MessageItem/isMe, raise MessageItemCache 50->96, raise WaveInboxQuery priority, guard ConversationListItem attachment visibility.
Prelaunch page-1 history query and Conversation.Cache warmup from Intent before super.onCreate, cache mSendMmsSupportViaWiFi, reduce compose/inbox allocations.
Defer iMessage foreground service/TLS startup 900ms past cold frame #1, pre-populate WaveIMessageDb infoCache off-main, create notification channel once.
Cache hardware isMultiSimEnabledMms and CountryDetector ISO, 1:1 zero-StringBuilder formatNames, short-circuit empty tapbacks.
Harvest in-flight Compose/Inbox root inflation Futures on cold start, raise pool priority, yield inbox row prewarm during cold chat open.
Single-IPC JPEG decodeCrispBitmap with RGB_565 thumbnails, guard drawRightStatusIndicator visibility, cache Compose XML config booleans.
